deployments_detail.use: AI-powered automated fresh produce ordering: Shelf Engine's probabilistic AI models forecast demand and generate SKU-level orders for highly perishable produce to reduce food waste and stockouts, rolled out nationally to ~3,000 stores by end of FY2023 after a 400+ store pilot. [Shelf Engine]

Cashierless / checkout-free store pilot using AiFi's camera-only computer vision to track item pick-up and automatically charge shoppers' linked payment, deployed at a store in Banner Elk, North Carolina (test-and-learn, not chainwide). [AiFi]

Agentic AI for always-on retail intelligence built with Tredence on Google Cloud (Gemini-powered): multi-agent systems for unified merchandising workflows (item setup to pricing), demand forecasting/reduced stockouts, dynamic markdowns, and autonomous replenishment across the supply chain. [Tredence, Google Cloud]
Shelf Engine AI/ML for fresh-produce ordering (rollout to 3,000 stores); appointed SVP of AI optimization

Enterprise AI optimization program led by newly hired SVP of AI Optimization Travis Nixon (ex-Meta/Dropbox/Microsoft), applying AI to business process management across supply chain, store operations, and merchandising to drive operational excellence and cost efficiency. Later elevated to Chief Data and AI Officer role. [none]

AI-enabled in-store audio media network (DG Media Network) that uses AI to generate voiceovers, curate music, and deliver localized, real-time targeted audio advertisements. Rolling out to ~6,000 stores across 48 states via QSIC, doubling audio reach to ~12,000 stores by Q2 2026. [QSIC]

DG Media Network retail media platform built on LiveRamp for identity resolution, privacy-safe clean-room data collaboration with 50+ brand partners, and closed-loop measurement/attribution across online and in-store shoppers. Operational since 2022 across the store network. [LiveRamp]
deployments_detail.value: 90M+ unique customer profiles, 1,400 attributes, 2B+ annual transactions, 47 states

deployments_detail.use: Unified retail media solution connecting DG's onsite inventory with The Trade Desk's offsite channels via Kevel's Retail Media Cloud, using AI-driven predictive segmentation, custom relevancy algorithms, and yield forecasting. Managed-service campaigns begin June 2026, full launch targeted Q3 2026. [Kevel, The Trade Desk]

AI analysis of self-checkout transactions for shrink/theft detection: Dollar General used AI to analyze hundreds of thousands of self-checkout purchases to identify which stores had the highest theft, informing decisions to remove or restrict self-checkout (300 stores full removal, 9,000 converted to staffed, 4,500 limited to 5 items). [none]
deployments_detail.value: hundreds of thousands of transactions analyzed; ~13,800 stores affected
